articles.title: JPMorgan backs U.S. crypto bill but warns of risks in digital asset framework
articles.snippet: The bank says Congress should pair regulatory clarity with safeguards as Senate negotiates the Clarity Act.

articles.title: BlackRock pushes deeper into DeFi with Ethena integration, sending ENA up 8%
articles.snippet: The deal adds Ethena's yield-generating token to BlackRock's risk management platform and create a $100 million liquidity facility for BlackRock's tokenized money market fund.

articles.title: Galaxy cuts CLARITY Act odds to 50% as Senate floor time narrows
articles.snippet: Galaxy cut its 2026 CLARITY Act odds to 50%, warning that Senate floor time is running out before the August recess.

articles.title: EU watchdog EBA details big crypto fines as landmark laws bite
articles.snippet: The European Banking Authority laid out a proposed penalty framework on Friday that can strip non-compliant significant token issuers of up to 12.5% of their annual revenue.

articles.title: Galaxy Slashes Clarity Act's 2026 Odds to 50% as Senate Time Runs Short
articles.snippet: The digital asset firm cut its odds of the market structure bill passing this year to a coin toss, pointing to a shrinking Senate calendar.
